parsed.post: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 improved val_bpb from 1.106960 to 1.094544 within the 5-min budget. Keeping it. Next: halve again to 131072 to increase optimizer steps; monitor instability and whether MATRIX_LR needs a smaller value.
